terraformNaming: The renderer maps Bicep camelCase input names to Terraform snake_case.
terraformRoot: Each platform-apps/<service>/terraform directory is a deployment root. Backend settings are supplied at initialization; provider versions and lock files are committed.
examples: Each service and language has a README and a parameter example under examples/platform. Bicep imports the local wrapper; Terraform runs the catalog root at the selected commit.
vmImage: Both implementations use the image version recorded in catalog/platform.json. Its regional availability was checked through the Azure API; recheck availability before deploying.
tags: The platform team supplies tags. Security settings are defined in the wrappers rather than exposed as developer configuration.
runtime: Web App uses NODE|24-lts, with patching managed by Azure and application ZIP deployment authenticated through Entra ID. Container App uses the image digest and port in catalog/platform.json.
applicationPayload: The Web App sample is a Node.js HTTP server with no external dependencies. Application releases are separate from infrastructure deployment so the infrastructure runner does not execute developer PR code.
validation: scripts/tooling.mjs installs local tools and verifies their checksums. npm run iac:check compiles and validates the examples without deploying to Azure. Container Apps mock tests are limited by the upstream ephemeral resource schema.
